import { execSync } from 'node:child_process';
execSync('uv run lintro fmt generated.mjs');
execSync('lintro fmt generated.mjs');
execSync('ruff check generated.py');
execSync('prettier --check generated.css');
const example = 'bunx oxfmt generated.mjs';
console.log('prettier --write generated.css');
console.log('example; black generated.py');

// Unsupported dynamic commands and split argument arrays remain unreported.
const formatter = 'black';
execSync(`${formatter} generated.py`);
spawnSync('ruff', ['format', 'generated.py']);
const run = execSync;
run('black generated.py');
execSync('/usr/bin/black generated.py');
execSync('uv run --no-sync black generated.py');
execSync(
  'black generated.py'
);
execSync('generate "input"; black generated.py');
